quarantined_leads.lead: WSB-TV reported that Democratic Senator Jon Ossoff demanded that Republican Representative Mike Collins testify under oath in the existing House ethics review concerning Collins's use of official resources. Collins said his office was fully cooperating and expected to be cleared.
quarantined_leads.source_title: Ossoff demands Collins testify under oath in ethics probe as Senate race heats up
quarantined_leads.subject_response: Representative Collins said his office was fully cooperating with the ethics committee and that he expected to be cleared soon.
quarantined_leads.reason: Collins's Republican congressional role and the underlying OCC referral are officially documented, but the in-window item is a single local report about campaign pressure and a demand for testimony, not a new House Ethics Committee or OCC action. No second independent in-window report or new official finding was located, so the lead is retained for follow-up and is not emitted as an event or published as an established ethics violation.
